text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: control-plane API 5xx rate spike detected (5m error rate 18%). Top errors: org-lookup timeout (502), auth proxy 504, billing gateway 502. Auto-pager: oncall-amber.
oncall-amber: picking this up — paging now. brief summary?
karina: seeing org-lookup lat p95 jump from 40ms -> 1.8s, increased retries hitting billing. Deps chain.
aj: logs show repeated upstream CONNECT timeout to org-lookup cluster: "timeout waiting for header". Also a lot of 429->retries from frontend.
ben: customers starting to see 502s on token exchange flows (reports from monitoring). I'm posting examples from logs.
ben: ```
2026-03-15T15:03:12Z controlplane gateway: upstream="org-lookup.prod.internal" status=504 err="context deadline exceeded" trace=abc123
2026-03-15T15:03:14Z controlplane auth-proxy: status=502 upstream="billing.svc" err="connect ECONNRESET"
```
oncall-amber: paging note: severity=P1 (customer impact: sign-in and token refresh). Escalating to SRE. @sre-lead can you join?
sre-lead: on it, joining. quick ask: do we have recent deploys to org-lookup or gateway?
karina: no deploy in the last 8h. Config rollouts show a TTL change to org-cache two days ago but no immediate correlation.
aj: traffic pattern changed — burst from eu-west region ~15:00 UTC, could be a client or a control-plane fanout.
oncall-amber: mitigation plan suggestions?
karina: immediate mitigations: 1) enable gateway circuit-breaker to cut retries to org-lookup 2) increase org-lookup pod replicas in prod for short term 3) route a fraction of traffic to org-lookup read-only cache.
ben: we can flip a feature-flag to reduce token refresh frequency for mobile SDKs too.
sre-lead: do steps in order: circuit-breaker -> cache-routing -> scale. I'll coordinate.
aj: running quick check to validate compatible fallback endpoints.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: AMBER escalated to SRE Team. Incident channel created.
karina: command to open circuit-breaker on gateway (copying):
```bash
# gateway admin API - create CB for org-lookup
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' \ 
  https://gateway-admin.prod.internal/cb -d '{"service":"org-lookup","failure_threshold":0.2,"sample_window_ms":60000,"open_ms":60000}'
```
karina: done — CB POST returned 201. Observability: immediate drop in retries.
ben: rolling scale on org-lookup: `kubectl -n prod scale deployment org-lookup --replicas=12` -> replicas increased from 4 -> 12.
aj: started redirect rule to serve stale cached responses for 10s when org-lookup is slow. Rule snippet:
```yaml
- match: /org/*
  fallback: cache_stale
  ttl_override: 10s
```
support-jess: notifying customer ops teams and posting banner for affected customers who reported sign-in issues. Draft: "We are investigating sign-in issues affecting token refresh for a subset of customers in EU; mitigation in progress."
oncall-amber: communications: set status -> investigating and add timeframe.
sre-lead: monitoring windows: p95 latency improving from 1.8s -> 250ms after CB + scale. 5xx rate down to 4% in last 2m.
ben: seeing billing gateway 502s still sporadic; tracing shows auth retries cascade to billing. Suggest temporary rate-limit on control-plane -> billing at 100rps to protect billing cluster.
karina: applied rate-limit rule at edge: `limit controlplane->billing 100rps` — rules returned OK.
aj: applied extra connection pool tuning on billing client to avoid resets.
incident-bot: Automation: created incident ticket INC-2026-0457 and linked runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/inc-0457
sre-lead: next steps: 1) keep scaled org-lookup until traffic normalizes 2) run deeper heap and latency profiling on org-lookup 3) follow-up fix for retry/backoff logic in gateway client 4) postmortem owner: karina.
support-jess: sent updates to affected customers with mitigation and ETA: 30m.
oncall-amber: handoff at 15:45 UTC to night oncall. leaving notes: CB enabled, replicas scaled, cache-fallback on, billing rate-limit in place. Please continue monitoring and reach out if regression.
aj: adding logs/links: traces: https://tracing.prod/trace/abc123, metrics dashboard: https://grafana.prod/d/CP/controlplane-errors?orgId=1
karina: quick debug snippet we used to validate health:
```bash
# test org lookup latency
time curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $SVC" https://org-lookup.prod.internal/orgs/123 | jq '.latency'
```
ben: follow-up: we observed root cause pattern: upstream org-lookup hosts had intermittent file descriptor exhaustion during a spike of concurrent list calls from a scheduled job. Sched-job disabled as long-term mitigation.
sre-lead: that's the key cause — disable job, add fd accounting, and a circuit-breaker in client.
oncall-amber: final status at handoff: mitigated -> 5xx rate degraded to <1.5%, customer impact reduced, active mitigations: scaling and CBs. Handoff to night SRE.
sre-lead: assigning timeline for RCA: publish within 48h. Karina will own postmortem.
support-jess: will update customers when postmortem is ready.
incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED (mitigated) — auto-close deferred for 2h for watch.
karina: adding runbook notes and follow-ups to the ticket: diagnostics, remediation steps, and code pointers (repo: infra/org-lookup client).
aj: thumbs for quick response :thumbsup:.
ben: leaving final log anchor:
```
2026-03-15T15:23:50Z controlplane gateway: error_rate=1.2% p95=230ms validated mitigation=ok\```
support-jess: marked customers alerted.
noncall-amber: thanks all — good ops teamwork.
